about: MOXIR 17.10, Minimal · X lying down · heads. The X hangs on chains: every cue whose heads change aim fades over at least 4 s (the rig file's truss.motion rules); the hit cuts its intensities, and the heads' own pan/tilt speed channel must hold a full-range move to >= 4 s on the desk (owed with the channel lists). RIG_BUILD.md §15.8.
